# rust-skills attribution

This repository vendors the upstream `SKILL.md` and complete `rules/` directory
from [leonardomso/rust-skills](https://github.com/leonardomso/rust-skills) at
commit `fd2a861ab0406a4ac536a55274d14ea6fd1ca9c9` (version 1.5.1), retrieved on
2026-09-16. The vendored guidance lives in `.agents/skills/rust/` so agents can
apply it while working on this Rust workspace.

The upstream project is licensed under MIT; its unmodified license text is
preserved alongside this record in `LICENSE`.
